name: draw
description: A hand-drawn canvas the agent and the user share: the agent draws diagrams for him (boxes, ellipses, diamonds, notes, arrows, groups, laid out for it), he edits them by hand (move, draw, write), the agent reads his edits back; export to SVG or PNG. Use it to sketch an architecture, a flow, a plan or an idea.

dev.bise.tagline: a hand-drawn canvas you and the agent share
prompts: sketch how the hub, the agents and the TUI talk to each other
draw the signup flow as boxes and arrows, I'll fix it by hand
look at what I changed in the drawing and update the plan
